d.title: Shakugan no Shana: Koi to Onsen no Kougai Gakushuu!
d.jp: 灼眼のシャナSP　恋と温泉の校外学習！
syn: Shakugan no Shana Tokubetsu Hen Koi to Onsen no Kougai Gakushuu!
Shakugan no Shana SP: Love and Outdoor Hot Spring Tutorial!
d.synopsis: Yuji and Shana's class go on a trip to see various temples and shrines, followed by a trip to a hot springs resort. During the trip, Matake Ogata tries to tell Eita Tanaka her feelings for him, but various complications and hijinks occur that prevent her from doing so.
